name: Nina Edwards
source:
Nina is one of the more lazy maids in the Ashley household and appears quite cold towards [url=/c829]Matthew[/url] at the beginning of the game. When she actually does work, however, she is very good at what she does. Nina is very skilled at knife throwing. She became a maid after she tried to rob [url=/c828]Robi[/url]’s mother.

[From [url=http://liemyx.wordpress.com/2011/05/16/rondo-leaflet-review/]Liemyx's blog[/url]]
